Ch 5
1. Evaluate the effectiveness of edge–cloud collaborative computing in reducing energy consumption and network traffic in a smart campus. Justify your answer with a suitable example
2. Assess how thermal-aware data center optimization can reduce cooling energy consumption and prevent server overheating. Support your answer with a suitable scenario. 
3. Evaluate the effectiveness of renewable-aware workload management in reducing the carbon footprint of a college data center. Justify your answer with a suitable example. 
4. Examine the practice of executing all computing workloads immediately, irrespective of server temperature or renewable energy availability. Suggest suitable green computing techniques to improve sustainability. 
5. Justify the selection of suitable green computing techniques for a data center that experiences high cooling costs, excessive network traffic, and limited renewable energy utilization. Explain how the selected techniques address these issues.
